title: Ready Shulker
description: Readily access your shulkers from your inventory via right-click
body:
# Ready Shulker

Right-click a shulker box in your inventory to:
1. Open it without placing it down
2. Insert the item you are carrying in your cursor

Only required server-side (works in single-player).

The mod currently only supports/is tested on 26.1.x
